notes: The Wear OS half of the Home Assistant Companion, from the same repository as the phone import: :wear declares 30 @Preview functions over the entity list, tile configuration, sensor management and onboarding surfaces, all Wear Compose Material. No multipreview annotations are involved (every preview is a plain @Preview), so previewAnnotations is not needed here. Same build caveat as the phone import: the root build applies dependencyLocking { lockAllConfigurations() }, handled by the pipeline's --write-locks. Licence: Apache-2.0.
